topic: Using std::basic_string with const member functions
explanation: In modern C++, std::basic_string (commonly std::string) provides member functions that are marked as const, allowing read-only access to the string's data without modifying the object. This enables safe, efficient retrieval of information such as the string's contents, size, or locale-related data, while maintaining const-correctness. Using const member functions is essential for designing APIs that guarantee immutability of objects when needed, facilitating safer and more predictable code.
